# Jewel Sports Network

> Belize's first dedicated, professional-grade sports media network, providing photography, highlight reels, and full event coverage for athletes, leagues, and sponsors.

Jewel Sports Network (JSPN) was founded by David Maheia to give Belizean sports the professional media treatment it deserves. JSPN covers games, tournaments, and athletes across Belize with a dedicated crew, not freelancers, delivering photography, video, and storytelling built specifically for the local sports scene. The site is a single page; the sections below are anchors on that one page, not separate URLs.

## Sections

- [About](https://jewelsportsnetwork.com/#about): JSPN's founding story, mission, and vision.
- [Services](https://jewelsportsnetwork.com/#services): Professional sports photography, highlight reels, player and team spotlights, live event coverage, branded video packages, and behind-the-scenes content.
- [Coverage](https://jewelsportsnetwork.com/#coverage): Past work, including full coverage of the NSC Super Nationals 2026 across 5 venues, 4 sports, and 7+ days.
- [Partner](https://jewelsportsnetwork.com/#partner): Partnership information for leagues, federations, athletes, and sponsors.
- [Contact](https://jewelsportsnetwork.com/#contact): Contact form and direct contact details.
